# `assets/material/SurfaceBinding.js`

> **Source:** `engine/assets/material/SurfaceBinding.js`

engine/assets/material/SurfaceBinding.js — bind materials to surfaces (spec §7).  Material assignment happens at the primitive/submesh level, not per-image. A SurfaceBinding records exactly which node/mesh/primitive a material covers, which UV set it uses, and (when known) the semantic part — so segmentation and editing can target real surfaces and bindings survive non-destructive splits.

## Functions

### `buildSurfaceBindings(model)`

Build surface bindings for a model (material ↔ primitive). Populates model.surfaceBindings and returns them.
